title: AI Comment Generator with Enhanced UI and 3D Elements

requirements.summary: Add comment length selection dropdown to AiCommentGenerator with Short/Medium/Long options
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown appears in AiCommentGenerator form with Short/Medium/Long options
Selected length is passed to comment generation function
Default selection is Medium

file_operations.description: Add a dropdown select input (using shadcn/ui Select component) for comment length with three options: Short (50-100 words), Medium (100-200 words), and Long (200-300 words). Set Medium as the default. Store the selected length in component state and pass it to the comment generation logic as a parameter. Position the dropdown above or beside the quantity input in the form layout.

requirements.summary: Enhance comment generation algorithm to produce completely unique comments every time
acceptanceCriteria: Each generation produces completely unique comments with no repetition
Rating symbol is seamlessly integrated into comment text
Comments vary in structure, vocabulary, and phrasing
Timestamp-based seeding ensures different results each time

file_operations.description: Update the comment generation logic to use timestamp-based seeding (Date.now()) combined with Math.random() for uniqueness. Implement multiple randomized sentence templates with varied structures (question-based, exclamation-based, statement-based). Create vocabulary pools for adjectives, verbs, and phrases that are randomly selected. Integrate the rating symbol naturally into the text using template interpolation. Ensure the selected comment length parameter controls the output verbosity by adjusting the number of sentences or phrases included.

requirements.summary: Fix list visibility glitch so comments appear instantly after generation
acceptanceCriteria: Comment list appears immediately after generation without requiring page refresh
No delay or blank state between generation and display
Comments render in the correct order

file_operations.description: Review the React Query cache invalidation and state update logic. Ensure that after successful comment generation, the getAllAiComments query is immediately invalidated and refetched. Verify that the component properly subscribes to query updates using the isLoading, isFetching, and data states. Remove any conditional rendering that might hide the table during updates. Ensure proper key props on list items for stable DOM updates.

In the createAiComment mutation's onSuccess callback, ensure immediate invalidation of the getAllAiComments query using queryClient.invalidateQueries. Consider adding optimistic updates that immediately append the new comment to the cache before the backend responds, then reconcile on success. Ensure the mutation returns the created comment data for optimistic rendering.

requirements.summary: Implement skeleton loader and typing effect animation for comment generation
acceptanceCriteria: Skeleton loader shows while waiting for generation to complete
Typing effect animates each comment appearing character-by-character
Animation speed is smooth and natural (not too fast or slow)
Loading state transitions smoothly to typed content

file_operations.description: Add skeleton loader UI using shadcn/ui Skeleton component that displays 3-5 placeholder rows while isLoading or isFetching is true. After data arrives, implement a typing effect animation by rendering each comment character-by-character using a custom hook or state-driven interval. Set typing speed to approximately 30-50ms per character for natural readability. Stagger the typing animation across multiple comments with a 200ms delay between each comment's start time. Ensure smooth transition from skeleton to typed content.

Create a custom React hook that accepts a text string and typing speed, then returns the partially-revealed text and a boolean indicating completion. Use useState to track the current character index and useEffect with setTimeout to incrementally reveal characters. Support cleanup on unmount. Export the hook for use in AiCommentTable.

requirements.summary: Create a lightweight CSS-only 3D rotating cube integrated into AdminPanel AI Comments tab
acceptanceCriteria: 3D cube uses only CSS 3D transforms (no heavy libraries)
Cube rotates continuously on multiple axes
Positioned to enhance aesthetics without blocking form elements
Matches dark theme with purple/pink gradient styling
Performance remains smooth with no lag

file_operations.description: Create a pure CSS 3D rotating cube component using CSS 3D transforms (perspective, rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ). Structure the cube with six face divs positioned absolutely using transform: translateZ. Apply continuous rotation animation using @keyframes with transform: rotateX() rotateY(). Style faces with semi-transparent purple/pink gradients matching the dark theme (using CSS variables from index.css). Set animation duration to 8-12 seconds for smooth, mesmerizing rotation. Use transform-style: preserve-3d on the container. Ensure the component is lightweight with no external dependencies.

Import and integrate the Css3DCube component into the AI Comments tab. Position it in a corner or offset location using absolute or fixed positioning (top-right or bottom-left corner) with appropriate z-index to ensure it doesn't obstruct the AiCommentGenerator form or AiCommentTable. Apply opacity or scale transforms on hover for subtle interactivity. Ensure it complements the existing dark theme and purple/pink gradient aesthetic.

requirements.summary: Optimize AiCommentGenerator loading speed and async operations
acceptanceCriteria: Comment generation doesn't freeze the UI
Main thread remains responsive during operations
Loading states provide clear feedback
Component renders quickly on initial load

file_operations.description: Ensure all async operations use React Query mutations which handle async state automatically. Verify that heavy computations (if any) are wrapped in useMemo or useCallback to prevent unnecessary recalculations. Use React.lazy for any heavy dependencies if applicable. Ensure loading states are properly displayed using the mutation's isLoading state. Avoid blocking the main thread by keeping the generation logic lightweight and delegating heavy work to the backend.

Review the mutation configuration to ensure proper error handling and retry logic that doesn't block the UI. Consider adding a timeout for long-running operations. Ensure mutations use optimistic updates where appropriate to provide instant feedback before backend confirmation. Verify that React Query's default staleTime and cacheTime settings are appropriate for this use case.

requirements.summary: Polish UI with smooth hover states, transitions, and modern styling
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements have smooth hover transitions
Input fields show clear focus states
Buttons have press feedback with scale/shadow effects
Consistent padding and spacing throughout
Dark theme with purple/pink gradients maintained
Transitions are smooth (200-300ms) and feel responsive

file_operations.description: Add smooth hover and focus transitions to all inputs and buttons using Tailwind transition utilities (transition-all duration-200). Enhance button hover states with scale (hover:scale-105), shadow (hover:shadow-lg), and brightness adjustments. Apply focus rings to inputs with focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500. Add active:scale-95 to buttons for press feedback. Ensure consistent spacing using Tailwind spacing scale (p-4, gap-4, space-y-4). Maintain the existing dark theme with purple/pink gradients.

Apply hover effects to table rows with hover:bg-opacity-10 hover:bg-purple-500 and transition-colors duration-200. Add smooth hover states to action buttons (copy, delete) with scale and shadow transforms. Enhance card shadows with hover:shadow-2xl transitions. Ensure consistent padding within table cells and between UI elements. Polish the empty state and loading skeleton with subtle animations.

Review and enhance global transition defaults. Add custom animation keyframes if needed for smooth micro-interactions. Ensure CSS variables for purple/pink gradients are consistently defined and accessible. Add utility classes for common hover states if not already present. Verify that dark theme colors are properly applied across all components.
